report.strategy: The reflex does all the work: Dijkstra over the grid with rocks blocked, pit/trap costs added, and a predator-proximity danger field, targeting the cheapest reachable food; if no food is reachable it flees maximizing min predator distance. It always returns an action, so I am only invoked for the mandatory 10-tick reports and for energy<=5 crises. That caps spend at roughly one call per 10 ticks.
report.changed: Nothing this report. The reflex has kept energy at 26/30 through 10 ticks with no predator contact, so changing it would risk a working policy. I only trimmed notes to reduce input tokens on future calls.
report.expected_savings: ~1 call/10 ticks, ~500-600 tokens per 10 ticks; budget 34k should cover 500+ ticks
report.notes: Reflex: Dijkstra->nearest food; rocks blocked; pit/trap costed; pred danger (adj 40, d2 12). Fallback flee. Always returns an action => I'm called only on 10-tick reports and energy<=5 crisis. Working well (t10: 26/30 energy). Only revisit reflex if a report shows energy trending down or predators multiplying.
